title: HSK 3.0 Word List Dataset: Free CSV and JSON Download (CC BY 4.0)
licenseExcerpts: A row for each of the 11,147 words on our HSK 3.0 map, in the same format whether you open the CSV in a spreadsheet or the JSON in your own code. Build flashcards, a frequency list, or a study app on top of it; the license only asks for a credit.
CC BY 4.0. Copy, adapt, and use it for any purpose, including commercially, as long as you give credit.
Read the full CC BY 4.0 license

The dataset does not include the CC-CEDICT dictionary text (CC-CEDICT is Share-Alike, and that term would carry into anything built from this dataset) and does not include audio. Audio plays only on the HearMandarin site.
Can I use this dataset commercially?  Yes. The license is CC BY 4.0, so you can use it in a paid app, a course, or any other product, as long as you credit HearMandarin with a link.

Why isn't the dictionary definition included?  The starting dictionary, CC-CEDICT, is licensed Share-Alike, which would force that same license onto anything built from this dataset. The gloss_en column is a short teaching gloss written or reviewed in-house instead, under the plain CC BY 4.0 terms above.
